title: Undergraduate D-Clearance (Politics, International Relations and Dornsife POIR)
text:
Note: this is a department page (Politics, International Relations / POIR, Dornsife). It shows Spring 2027 dates. The page does not define D-clearance; it describes the process for POIR courses only. For other departments, check that department's page.

WHEN D-CLEARANCE IS NEEDED (POIR)
- IR courses: several have specific D-clearance policies (see below).
- POSC courses: generally not required, except POSC 391/392, 395, 396 and 398, which require an application or instructor permission.
- Directed Research (IR/POSC 490x): requires approval and D-clearance.
- Maymesters, D.C. Capital Campus courses, and summer faculty-led programs: by application only. Only students admitted to these programs will be granted D-clearance.

HOW TO REQUEST (POIR)
- IR courses: submit through the Spring 2027 D-Clearance Request Form (link on the original page). "We will not process D-Clearance requests via email." Requests by POIR students are typically processed within 2-3 business days, and students are notified when granted.
- Closed courses: complete the Permission to Add a Closed Course Form and email it to poir@usc.edu. The department approves only if the student is a senior graduating within the academic year, the course is required for degree progress, and no alternatives exist.
- Directed Research: submit the IR/POSC 490x Form and a faculty-developed syllabus to the Director of Undergraduate Studies in DMC 330 by the end of the first week of classes. Up to 4.0 units can count as major elective credit, but not toward the IR 400-level requirement.
- POSC 398 (Mock Trial): tryouts are in the fall. Otherwise, students need instructor permission starting the second week of classes.
- IR 494 and POSC 391/392 (Honors): apply in the spring. D-clearance is granted once the instructor confirms admission. Applications for 2026-2027 were due April 12, 2026. For IR 494, you can also email the instructor starting the second week of classes.

COURSE-SPECIFIC POLICIES
- IR 210: reserved for IR majors and minors, incoming transfer and new IR students, and majors whose programs require it, until after transfer/new student registration. Other students may request in early August (Fall) or mid-December (Spring) if seats remain.
- IR 304 and IR 320: initially limited to INCO majors graduating within two semesters or less. Starting Week 4, all IR majors may request, based on class standing. Other majors may request after new student/transfer registration. IR 320 is offered only in the fall.
- IR 339: priority goes to IR and Health and Human Services majors until Week 4.
- IR 391, POSC 395, POSC 396 (internships): contact unruhins@usc.edu or Professor Iva Bozovic.

SEAT GUARANTEE
- "Approval for D-Clearance does not guarantee students a seat in the course." Registration depends on seat availability and classroom capacity.

KEY DATES (SPRING 2027)
- Registration begins: October 26, 2026
- Classes begin: January 11, 2027
- Last day of add/drop: January 29, 2027

ADVISING
- "Students are strongly encouraged to make an appointment with an academic advisor as early as possible."
- Department contacts: poir@usc.edu (closed-course forms); unruhins@usc.edu (internships).
